description:
Navigate to the GCompris 'Target' activity (a dart-throwing math game). You can find it by searching for 'target' or looking in the Math/Arithmetic category. 

Once inside the activity:
1. Throw darts at the target by clicking on the rings.
2. Calculate the total score by summing the values of the rings hit.
3. Enter the calculated sum using the on-screen keypad/input.
4. Complete at least 3 levels (rounds) successfully.
5. After completing 3 levels, return to the main menu.
